Your Honor, we are offering the testimony of Ms. Marizza B. Grande to prove the following. Number one, the PSA verified all 2,669 alleged payees of the OVP and DepEd confidential funds for 2022 and 2023, one name at a time. Sa kahilingan ng House Committee on Good Government and Public Accountability, dumaan sa apat na phase ang bawat pangalan. 1,992 mula sa OVP at 677 sa DepEd. Hindi ito pagsulyap sa listahan. Isa-isang paghanap ito sa buong CRS. Number two, 1,685 of the 2,669 alleged payees have no birth record, no marriage record, and no death record at all. 398 sa 677 pangalan ng DepEd at 1,287 sa 1,999 ng OVP. Walang maipakitang Estado na sila ay isinilang, nag-asawa, o namatay kailanman sa Pilipinas. Number 3. At least 152 of the 2,669 had a single matched entry in the CRS. Ibig sabihin, sa humigit kumulang 100 milyong records sa PSA, iisa lamang ang tumugma sa pangalan kaya natukoy ang mismong tao at nailabas ang certified copies ng kanilang civil registry documents. Number 4 At least 37 of those single match names were already dead. 32 mula sa OVP at 5 sa DepEd. Lahat may certificate of death sa CRS. Patay na sila ayon sa talaan ng Republika nang umano'y tanggapin nila ang confidential funds. Number five, at least 25 were children. Dalawampu mula sa OVP at lima sa DepEd. Six hanggang 16 na taong gulang noong 2023. At tatlo sa kanila ay wala pang three years old. In short, 6. Confidential funds were liquidated in the names of the non-existent, the long-dead, and children.
